title: The Moon went red. Capricorn worried.
caption: In a lunar eclipse the Moon sits in Earth's shadow, and a little red sunlight still bends in to reach it. Hard weeks can feel like that shadow. Let your people in; some light always finds you. Send this to someone having a hard week.
